title: Seafood Social Set
blurb: Twelve posts built on one rule: the dish is the poster. Deep blue water backdrops, a single serif line, and zero clip-art — the kind of feed a coastal restaurant can actually sustain weekly.
alt: Seafood restaurant social media post with boat photograph and teal typographic layout
details: Repeatable weekly template: dish, one line, logo, nothing else.
Blue and sand palette pulled from the coastline, tested on small phone screens.
Handoff includes a photo brief so new dishes can be shot in the same language.
